questions.q: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart?
questions.why: The pulmonary vein carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

questions.q: HR = 60 bpm and SV = 80 ml. What is cardiac output?
What happens to the diaphragm during inspiration?
questions.why: It contracts and flattens, increasing chest volume so air flows in.

questions.q: Explain how oxygen gets from the alveoli into the blood.
questions.model: There is more oxygen in the alveoli than in the blood in the capillaries, so oxygen diffuses across the thin walls into the blood and binds to haemoglobin in red blood cells.
points: higher concentration in alveoli / concentration gradient
diffuses across thin alveolar and capillary walls
